item.title: Saved-context answers stay focused
item.summary: Murph keeps private replies focused by bringing in a small set of relevant saved facts and naming the exact target in suitability answers.
item.details: Your latest message and the current saved record still win. Background cleanup reads accepted voice-note transcripts like ordinary conversation, leaves newer corrections untouched, and retires a saved fact when your recent conversation makes clear it no longer applies; full detail remains available on demand.
